test_title: PYST 2: SSC Stenographer - Reasoning (Held on: 11 Nov 2021 Shift 2 )
subject: reasoning
question:
Three statements are given, followed by three conclusions numbered I, II and III. Assuming the statement s to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

Some machines are coolers.

All coolers are robots.

Some microwaves are coolers.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some coolers are machines.

II. Some robots are machines.

III. No robot is a microwave.

options.text: Only conclusions I and III follow
Only conclusions I and II follow
Either conclusion I or III follows

solution:
The least possible Venn Diagram is as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/853f5ab01ec2f2d6ab38d8b5d9ea387eb1c2eeaaa1d8db85bdba1c811f62b31f.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some coolers are machines. → Follows (because some machines are coolers, that's why some coolers will be machines too.)

II. Some robots are machines. → Follows (because some machines are coolers and all coolers are robots, hence Some robots will be machines too.)

III. No robot is a microwave. → Does not follow (because some microwaves are coolers and all coolers are robots, hence Some robots will be microwaves too.)

Hence, “Only conclusions I and II follow”.
